opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return).
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines for submission. Decisions typically within 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1 million).
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round (no deadlines), reviewed on a rolling basis; if taken forward, invited to submit a full proposal.
